digest.component_or_area: LLM prompt caching for plan review
propositions: Prompt cache writes are generated on every plan-review gate call but never read across calls, wasting premium-rate cache tokens with zero benefit.
The marked prefix breakpoint sits after pass-specific stance suffixes rather than at the shared byte-stable boundary, preventing within-run cache reads across the finder and verifier passes.

The plan text is embedded in the marked prefix by design for within-run fan-out reuse; content-addressed caching cannot reuse plan-bearing prefixes across different tickets, making cross-ticket prefix identity unsatisfiable.
The diagnostic warn_if_cache_ineffective only flags write==0 AND read==0, remaining blind to the write-every-call/read-0 pattern that costs ~9k premium tokens per leaf review with zero benefit.

Relocating the cache breakpoint to the end of the byte-stable shared_plan_prefix boundary enables the finder's cache write to be read by Pass-2 verifier steps within a single run and by same-ticket re-reviews within the TTL.

The prerequisite-verifier template embeds the plan after the stance (not leading with shared_prefix), blocking shared-prefix cache reuse; reordering it to lead with shared_prefix and passing it through workflow outputs enables cross-pass reads.
